name: blind_slot_back_face
why: The blind slot on the «back» face. EVERY FACE, NOT JUST ONE: the direction of the arcs is a constant in the plane of the SKETCH, while the points are built in the system of the MODEL, and the transformation between the two does not preserve handedness -- for two opposite faces the Y axis comes out inverted. If the direction is wrong on this face, the slot comes out 40 long instead of 51 with the ends bitten off: area 344.97 instead of 535.03, and the volume says so at once.

expect.tolerance_why: (51-11)*11 + pi*5.5^2 = 535.0332: the operation rounds to the hundredth
480000 minus 535.0332 over 5 of depth: the calculation has pi inside
